tools.name: check_message
tools.title: Check a message for scams
tools.description: Analyzes a suspicious SMS, Messenger, email or phone-call description for Bangladeshi scam patterns (fake bKash/Nagad 'wrong send' transfers, OTP/PIN theft, fake job offers, lottery wins, phishing links, impersonation) and returns a risk verdict, a 0-100 risk score, the exact red flags, and next steps.

sender.description: Who sent it, e.g. a phone number or name

channel.description: How it was sent: SMS, WhatsApp, Messenger, Email, Phone call, Website, or Other

tools.name: get_practice_round
tools.title: Get a scam-spotting practice round
tools.description: Generates a round of 5 short practice messages (a mix of real Bangladeshi scam patterns and genuine messages) for a 'spot the scam' quiz, used to train scam awareness.

tools.name: report_scam_sender
tools.title: Report a scam sender
tools.description: Flags a phone number, bKash/Nagad account number, or sender name as a scam source in ScamShield BD's public community database, so future checks warn other users. No login required.

identifier.description: The phone number, account number, or sender name to report

note.description: Optional short note about what happened

tools.name: lookup_scam_reports
tools.title: Look up scam reports for a sender
tools.description: Checks how many times a phone number, account number, or sender name has already been reported as a scam by the ScamShield BD community.

identifier.description: The phone number, account number, or sender name to look up
